title: "Components Overview"

## Main Electronic and Mechanical Components

| Component | Function in the prototype |
|---|---|
| Raspberry Pi 3 | High-level control, display interface, PNG interpretation and vision pipeline |
| Pimoroni GFX HAT | Embedded LCD and touch-button user interface |
| ESP32 | Direct servomotor control and microswitch acquisition |
| Three servomotors | Physical selection of the three yarn channels |
| 3D-printed servo arms | Custom mechanical interfaces for yarn selection |
| Microswitch | Synchronization event for pattern advancement |
| Raspberry Pi Camera | Image acquisition for the error-recognition subsystem |
| 3D-printed camera mount | Repeatable camera positioning near the hook region |
| External DC-DC converter | Regulated 5 V supply dedicated to the servomotors |
| USB flash drive | Transfer of PNG pattern files to the Raspberry Pi |
